lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region. The spots are arranged in a semi-regular grid, with larger, more widely spaced blobs occurring along the mid-lateral line and smaller, more densely clustered blobs approaching the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a geometric grid pattern across the mid-flank of the specimen.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the lateral flank. The most superior ridge exhibits a sharp horizontal gradient with high-intensity luminance on its dorsal edge and a pronounced shadow on its ventral edge, extending from the posterior gill slits toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots. These blobs are irregularly positioned across the anterior and medial portions of the fin's silhouette, with a notably lower density compared to the adjacent lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly complex, labyrinthine or vermicular pattern of fine white lines and punctate spots is present on the head region, specifically anterior to the first gill slit.
